newsitem.title: NORWAY: Oslo FIBA Nordic broker to end links with FIBA UK.
newsitem.headline: Oslo FIBA Nordic broker to end links with FIBA UK.

text.p: Oslo-based brokerage house FIBA Nordic Securities AS (FIBA AS) said on Thursday it had agreed with London-based FIBA-linked broker FIBA Nordic Securities (UK) Ltd (FIBA UK) to terminate their contractual relationship.

"After looking into various alternatives the board of both companies have together decided to end the ownership links and wind up their cooperation. This will take place shortly," said a company statement.
FIBA Nordic Securities in Norway and London came under the spotlight last year linked to a share fund scandal involving Morgan Grenfell Asset Management Ltd (MGAM).
FIBA AS is a wholly-owned subsidiary of FIBA ASA, which is listed on the Oslo bourse. FIBA AS owns 10 percent of FIBA UK, which in turns owns 100 percent of FIBA Nordic Securities AB in Stockholm.
FIBA AS and FIBA UK present separate profit and loss statements but have cooperated in a number of areas including the back office.

FIBA AS will receive stg 1.375 million in settlement for its 10 percent share in FIBA UK and as compensation for winding up of the relationship. FIBA AS will continue to provide back office and settlement services for FIBA UK at least until July, the statement said.
"The boards of both companies view positively the opportunity to develop their respective businesses within stockbroking individually, and without geographical restrictions," it said.
"The earlier cooperation agreements tied both parties in a way which at times hindered them from providing an optimal service to their clients."
Both companies will change names before the summer.
FIBA Nordic Securities Inc. in New York will continue its operations as a wholly-owned subsidiary of FIBA AS.
